run_multimodal_inference: run the ChameleonInferenceModel to generate text from an image and text prompt
create_inference_model: create a ChameleonInferenceModel instance with model weights, text tokenizer, and VQGAN config paths
generate_multimodal_tokens: generate tokens from a multimodal prompt containing image, text, and sentinel entries
decode_generated_tokens: decode generated token output back into readable text using decode_text
run_main_example: run the main function to demonstrate multimodal input inference with an image and question
